text: VHYL is quoted here in GBP from the London listing because that is the line with a Friday close in the data I could reach; the watch list defines it as the USD distribution share class, so the GBP figure carries a ~1.1% GBP/USD drift relative to the USD line. Its top-5 also comes from etftrace rather than stockanalysis, since stockanalysis returns no holdings page for ETR:VHYL.
